title: lactuca hastata var. paniculata
intro: Lactuca hastata var. paniculata, commonly known as Wild Lettuce or Tall Lettuce, is a plant species in the dandelion-like genus Lactuca. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate conditions such as insomnia and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Wild Lettuce include sedation, anxiolysis, and pain relief, primarily due to its bioactive constituents, including lactucarium, lactucopicrin, and flavonoids. These bioactive compounds may also exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to the plant's therapeutic effects.
